title: Source-assisted v4 complex word with PR189's bit supplier: conditional κ = 6.674324e-4
body:
## Result

Conditional κ = 1668581/2500000000 = **0.0006674324**. This is about 0.838% above PR186 (0.000661885549259598) and 0.398% above PR193 (0.0006647872).

## What changed

PR193's complex supplier has saving 219037/312500000 = 0.0007009184. That is far above every published bit supplier, so the bit side binds.

This PR keeps PR193's complex word and replaces PR184's bit supplier with PR189's face-diagonal bit word (chafreaky). `assemble.py` reads PR189's certified bit profile (R = 17,554, W = 21,074, rank mass 1,515,392, deficit 1,936, largest child 60). It prices that profile with PR184's own `select()`: bad-row allowance 10^-16 with fallback 32 m^2 per edge, coarse saving on the 10^-10 grid, least payable atom on the 10^-12 grid, ordinary leaf 384599/10^10. It then runs PR184's `assemble()` unchanged: finite bridge, 47 strict constraints and seven margins.

| Version | Complex saving | Bit supplier | Bit effective saving | κ |
| --- | ---: | --- | ---: | ---: |
| PR191 | 6.630702e-4 | PR184 | 6.652295e-4 | 6.626307e-4 |
| PR193 | 7.009184e-4 | PR184 | 6.652295e-4 | 6.647872e-4 |
| this PR | 7.009184e-4 | PR189 | 6.678782e-4 | **6.674324e-4** |

The bit coarse saving on PR184's grid is 6682989/10^10. The script checks that this does not exceed PR189's own 10^-18 certificate value, 668298937775631/10^18.

## Verify

```sh
python3 -m pip install -r research/source-assisted/requirements-round13.txt
python3 -B research/source-assisted-v4/verify.py
python3 -B research/paired-cube-twin-local-168/verify.py
```

The first command takes about one minute and regenerates the complex word, flow, exact lift, contract checks and assembly. The second is PR189's own verifier (about two minutes). It regenerates the bit certificate that `assemble.py` reads. The workflow `.github/workflows/source-assisted-v4.yml` runs both.

## Branch

The branch is PR193 plus PR189's commit (cherry-picked) plus one commit. That commit adds `assemble.py`, updates the package, and updates nine stale hash values in PR189's manifest (README.md, Makefile, NOTICE, SOURCES.json, the verify workflow, docs/reproducibility.md and the joint-dual files). PR189's verifier passes on this branch.

## Scope

The complex supplier keeps PR184's validation scope: exact local lifts and contract checks, no globally renumbered scalar transcript and no full Clifford/router replay. The bit supplier keeps PR189's scope. PR184's finite bridge needs m ≤ 72, W < 10^7 and the uniform bit interface, which PR189's word shares with PR168 v4. The analytic, recursion, precision, weighted frame, fixed-tape routing, restored-row and all-size interfaces stay as assumptions.
